shared_elements: short angular or zigzag linear marks
justification: The only clear correspondences are very generic schematic linear motifs: A has a large curved arc with angular appendage-like marks, while B includes curved bands and some rectilinear incised markings. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by a frontal anthropomorphic figure with face, torso, circular features, and bands, whereas A shows a small isolated animal-like or abstract arched motif with no comparable human figure or iconographic scheme.
